summary.headline: Ujjivan SFB's MD and CEO Sanjeev Nautiyal retired early; Carol Furtado is Interim MD and management reiterated FY27 guidance with 29% loan growth.
summary.overview: The call was an unscheduled management briefing on the early retirement of MD and CEO Sanjeev Nautiyal, whose health has been poor since mid-July. Whole-time Director Carol Furtado will act as Interim MD and CEO, subject to RBI approval, and the NRC has begun a successor search that the Chairman expects to finish in 3 to 4 months. Management cited Q1 FY27 loan book growth of about 29% YoY, GNPA of 2.2%, CASA growth of 38% YoY and cost of funds of 6.9%, and said FY27 guidance is unchanged. Management also said there is no material factor behind the exit beyond Nautiyal's health, and that El Nino is not currently affecting asset quality.

financial_highlights.metric: Secured book share of loan book

segments.name: Secured loan book
segments.commentary: Secured share of the loan book has moved past 50% as part of the diversification strategy; management said secured asset quality tracked in line with or better than Q1 post-quarter.

segments.name: Unsecured book
segments.commentary: Management said unsecured asset quality has tracked in line with or better than Q1 performance, with no deviation seen as of the call date.

segments.name: MSME
segments.commentary: Vikas Agarwal, a Chartered Accountant with over 25 years in MSME, business banking and retail, joins as Business Head, MSME; management said MSME plans are on track for FY27 and more detail will come in the Q2 call.

guidance_outlook: Management said the bank remains on track to meet FY27 guidance, with no change to the strategy previously communicated.
Asked whether a delayed capital raise would affect FY27 growth, Carol Furtado said the bank is well capitalised for FY27 growth plans and that a delay would not affect FY27 performance.
Management said the festive season looks promising, supported by capacity additions and a brand campaign planned for launch during the festive season.
Management declined to give a timeline for the transition to a universal bank, saying it is proceeding with the diversification strategy.
capex_capacity: Management referred to capacity additions supporting the festive-season outlook but gave no figures on capacity, capex or commissioning.
Management referred to strategic spends planned for FY27 without quantifying them.
demand_pricing: Management said liability and asset product performance has gained momentum, and that the market is under pressure on deposits, yet CASA grew 38% YoY.
No figures were given on pricing, yields or competition.

qa_highlights.question: Will a delayed capital raise after the management change affect growth over the next 2 to 3 quarters?
qa_highlights.answer: Carol Furtado said the bank remains on track for FY27 guidance and is well capitalised for its FY27 growth plans, so a delay would not affect FY27 performance.

qa_highlights.question: Is there an early view on the successor, and what is the timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Chairman B.A. Prabhakar said the search started early, versus a planned October-November start, and names should go to the RBI in 3 to 4 months. He said the timing of joining was too early to say.

qa_highlights.question: Will internal candidates be considered, and will Carol Furtado be a candidate for permanent MD?
qa_highlights.answer: Prabhakar said internal candidates will be considered and that Furtado has expressed interest in a regular MD role.

qa_highlights.question: Is there any material reason for the abrupt exit beyond health?
qa_highlights.answer: Prabhakar said there was no issue with business strategy or bank operations and that the exit was Nautiyal's personal decision.

qa_highlights.question: Is El Nino affecting asset quality or growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Furtado said trends are in line with or better than Q1 for both secured and unsecured books and that no deviations are seen, with nothing material to report.

qa_highlights.question: What profile is sought for external candidates?
qa_highlights.answer: Prabhakar said the profile is still being worked out and will be shared later.

risks_watch: Leadership continuity: the MD and CEO search is expected to take 3 to 4 months to reach RBI submission, and a new MD may not join for several months after that.
Capital raise: the Board has approved a raise, but timing is now uncertain after the management change; management says FY27 is unaffected.
Universal bank transition: management declined to give a timeline, so this remains open.
El Nino and weather risk: management says there is no impact so far, but the issue was flagged earlier as a key monitorable for asset quality and growth.
MSME mix shift: new MSME head's impact on the business mix is not yet quantified.
summary.management_tone: Confident and reassuring on FY27 guidance and capital, but guarded on the succession timeline and the universal bank transition. Management repeated "on track" statements and declined to give detail on external candidate profiles and the transition timeline.
key_quotes: We remain on track to meet our FY27 guidance, and we are committed to delivering a strong performance.
